pr_title: Fix bmw connected drive door_lock_state attribute error
pr_body:
## Breaking change
n/a

## Proposed change
For certain cars without `door_lock_state` info the integration would give an AttributeError.
That is being fixed in this PR.
Issues ->
#28806
https://github.com/bimmerconnected/bimmer_connected/issues/145

Besides that some extra information from the library is added to the attributes of the binary sensors, sensors and lock.

issue_context.title: [bmw_connected_drive] door_lock_state 'NoneType'
issue_context.body:
**Home Assistant release with the issue:**
0.101.3

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
Hass.io

**Integration:**
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/bmw_connected_drive

**Description of problem:**
Lock component fails, due to missing `vehicle_state` attributes.

**Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` entries and (fill out even if it seems unimportant):**
```yaml
bmw_connected_drive:
  bendik:
    username: !secret bmw_connected_username
    password: !secret bmw_connected_password
    region: "rest_of_world"
```

**Traceback (if applicable):**
```
ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.core] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 275, in async_update_ha_state
    self._async_write_ha_state()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 317, in _async_write_ha_state
    attr.update(self.device_state_attributes or {})
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/bmw_connected_drive/lock.py", line 64, in device_state_attributes
    "door_lock_state": vehicle_state.door_lock_state.value,
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'value'
```

**Additional information:**
The services (light flash, horn etc) works OK.
My car (2016 4-series, NBTEvo) does not push its state to BMW servers, so for the lock state and position data to get updated - it needs to pull from the car (remote service). Any chance this can be implemented?
